newsitem.title: USA: Del Webb sees yr EPS range $2.10 and $2.20.
newsitem.headline: Del Webb sees yr EPS range $2.10 and $2.20.

text.p: Del Webb Corp said on Thursday that it expects to report earnings of $2.10 to $2.20 a share for the year ending June 30, 1997, and the company will have a tough comparison for fiscal 1998.
This reflects a charge of $0.07 a share for the third quarter ended March 31 for the early retirement of debt, Del Webb said.
For the first six months of the company's fiscal year, it reported earnings per share of $0.94 on sales of $558.0 million, Del Webb said.

Del Webb, a developer of homes for people 55 and older, reported operating earnings of $1.96 a share for the year ended June 1996. Including a accounting change, the company had reported a loss of $0.44 a share for the period.
Chief financial officer John Spencer had addressed analysts about the company's outlook earlier today.
Spencer said in a statement that fiscal 1998 earnings and earnings per share will be difficult to maintain at the record level expected this year.
The company anticipates higher interest rates, a lack of new developments and a lower backlog, as well as the build out of its North Scottsdale, Ariz. development to affect results.
The company is interested in several new regions of the country and has been investigating the greater Chicago and Williamsburg, Virginia, areas as possible Sun City locations.

In order to serve the broadest possible segment of the retiree home-buying market, Del Webb is also planning two smaller adult communities with more limited amenities near Tucson, Ariz. and Cloverdale, Calif.
